flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi: toppan/upload/{jobs/ToppanUploadJob,helpers/AnLetterPdfService,helpers/ToppanUploadHelper} (ANL PDFs to intranet blob). ocmseserviceapi: workflows/spcp/controller/SpcpController, workflows/furnish/FurnishApplicationListServiceImpl, workflows/receipt/controller/ReceiptController. ocmseserviceui: route/route.ts, pages/{Payment,Furnish}. ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminui, thirdpartyapi: no letter code for the portal
note: Requirement given (status 'Requirement given - Gen flow'); demo_remark: 'Sync to eService for motorist viewing. Have function?'. The story asks for PDF copies of letters (past X months, X from a parameter in OCMS) to be uploaded to the Online Customer Portal so the logged-in user can view/download them. Search result: this function does not exist. eService only has payment, furnish and the receipt printslip; there is no table, sync job, endpoint, page or parameter for letters. What exists is only the OCMS side building ANL stage PDFs into intranet blob (not RD/DN) and a generic Singpass login. No maintenance ticket touches this feature. The active ocmsadminprivateapi code is in src/main/java; the cronservice folder is an old uncompiled copy. Whether the feature is built in another repo or by a DB process outside the repo: cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Do not claim as done. There is no PDF letter upload/sync to the portal, no X-months parameter, and no view/download letter page. Ask URA/the team to confirm which repo holds this feature (demo_remark: 'Have function?'), or mark it as a gap.

steps.step: PDF copies of the letters sent to the vendor are available
steps.detail: OCMS only builds PDFs for the ANL stage (generateAnLetterPdfs -> AnLetterPdfService.generateAnLetterPdf, files AN-LETTER-<...>.pdf; ToppanUploadHelper.java:356, ToppanUploadJob.java:325-333). RD1/RD2/RR3/DN1/DN2/DR3 letters go out as D1 data files (ToppanUploadJob.java:314) and Toppan builds the PDF, so there is no OCMS PDF copy. The ANL PDFs are stored in intranet blob and SFTP, not on the portal side.

steps.step: OCMS uploads those PDF copies to the Online Customer Portal
steps.detail: No code was found that sends or syncs letter PDFs to the portal side. Searches for 'letter', 'toppan', 'reminder', 'pdf' and 'blob' in ocmseserviceapi and ocmseserviceui found nothing related to letters: the eService blob util is only used for furnish document uploads and receipt PDFs (workflows/receipt, workflows/uploadfile). In ocmsadminprivateapi the ANL PDFs are only uploaded to the intranet blob folder (ToppanUploadJob.java:325-333), with no sync job to the Internet DB or the eService blob. Search: graphify/grep over the six repos, synonyms letter/toppan/reminder/notice copy/pdf.

steps.step: Only letters of the past X months are uploaded, with X set by a parameter in OCMS
steps.detail: There is no parameter or property holding a number of months for letters (checked application*.properties in ocmsadminprivateapi and ocmseserviceapi, and searched 'month' and 'minusMonths'). The only month window in eService is in the furnish list and is hardcoded to 6 and 3 months (FurnishApplicationListServiceImpl.java:172-173), unrelated to letters. Rows in the DB parameter table: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The user opens and logs in to the Online Customer Portal
steps.detail: The existing Singpass/Corppass login creates a session with the NRIC and a JWT (SpcpController.java:118, :122), but it serves the payment and furnish pages: the UI only has the payment and furnish-particulars routes (route.ts:17-38). A generic login exists, but no letter page is reachable. Singpass handshake: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The portal shows the list of letters sent to the logged-in user
steps.detail: The UI routes are only payment, payment/processing, payment/success, payment/failure and furnish-particulars (route.ts:17-38). The existing eService API endpoints are parkingfines, furnishapplication(list), printslip, spcp, the epayment callback and upload/temp; there is no endpoint or page that lists letters. The pages folder only contains Furnish and Payment.

steps.step: The user can view/download a PDF copy of the letter
steps.detail: The only print/download PDF function on the portal is printslip for payment receipts (ReceiptController.java:38), not letters. There is no view or download function for letter PDFs.
